narrative_drafts.about_us_draft:
Mark Squire Roof Restorations is a Ballarat East roof restoration and repair business operating since 1996. Based at 4 Eureka Terrace, Ballarat East, Mark works with homeowners and property owners across Ballarat and Central Victoria who want practical roofing advice, careful preparation and long-lasting results. The business is listed on Google as a 5-star roofing contractor and on Yellow Pages as a trusted roof restoration and repairs provider with 30 years in business.

The work is built around Mark Squire's personal involvement. The Yellow Pages profile states that all work is personally completed by Mark Squire, giving customers a direct line to the person responsible for the finished result. Mark specialises in roof cleaning, roof de-mossing, repointing, roof painting and full roof restorations. Every stage matters: cleaning reveals the real condition of the roof, de-mossing removes growth that can shorten roof life, repointing strengthens tile details and painting or coating restores the finish.

Mark uses quality products throughout his restorations and backs full roof restorations with a 15-year guarantee. The business is fully insured, and the service promise is simple: expert guidance, quality workmanship and lasting results. For broader roofing needs, Mark Squire Roof Restorations can coordinate skilled tradespersons for roof plumbing, iron roofing, gutter installation and cleaning, downpipes, new tile and Colorbond roofs and drain cleaning.

Whether your roof needs a clean, repair, de-mossing, repointing, painting or a complete restoration, the first step is a conversation and quote. Call Mark on 0400 058 842 or request a free quote to discuss your roof, your suburb and the most suitable way to restore or repair it.
narrative_drafts.trust_signals_catalog:
Trust signals should be collected into a visible proof band on every major page. Verified signals include the business name Mark Squire Roof Restorations, the Google Business Profile rating of 5 stars from 3 reviews, the address 4 Eureka Terrace, Ballarat East VIC 3350, phone 0400 058 842 and the Yellow Pages ABN number 49 809 953 319. Yellow Pages also verifies the business as established in 1996, with 30 years in business and 4 years with Yellow Pages.

Warranty and risk-reversal signals are especially important. Yellow Pages states '15 years of guarantee on all roof restorations' and 'Fully insured for peace of mind.' It also lists 'Affordable and competitive pricing,' 'Quality workmanship & lasting results' and 'All work personally completed by Mark Squire.' These should appear in short chips near quote CTAs and in fuller form on service pages.

Operational trust signals include published hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 am to 6:00 pm, Saturday 9:00 am to 5:00 pm, Sunday closed. Payment methods listed are cash, EFT, cheque, Mastercard and Visa. Missing trust signals that should be verified before launch include ABN entity type, any VBA or relevant Victorian licence number, product brands used, written guarantee terms and real Google review text.
